update-pricing-math.note: 4 questions need VHR answers before the app's calculations and display can be finalized. See questions.md for the full text of each question.
update-pricing-math.brief:
Get VHR answers to the 4 open questions in management/questions.md. Each answer has a direct code consequence:

1. WC fees (shared_claim_fee, min_wc_fee_per_week, safety_claim_fee) — wire into billing math or remove the fields.
2. Missouri SUTA — confirm billing formula is same as other VHR-reporting states, or adjust.
3. Broker commission base — confirm broker_admin_pct and broker_wc_pct apply independently (current behavior), or fix if wrong.
4. Proposal FICA/FUTA — add or remove those line items from the Proposal section of the Deal Summary.

Once answers are in hand, make the corresponding code changes and update pricing_math.md.

To close: remove 'update-pricing-math' from management/status.json and add a one-line summary to management/updates.md.
